stem: A company wants to rent hardware in a cloud datacenter and decide for itself which operating system and software to run. Which service type is this?
why_correct: IaaS is the most flexible category. You rent the hardware in a cloud datacenter, and what you do with it is up to you.
why_a_wrong: With SaaS you use a fully developed application and do not choose the operating system.
why_c_wrong: With PaaS the provider maintains the operating systems and middleware, so you do not choose them.
why_d_wrong: A ready-made email app is SaaS, so you do not control the operating system.
author: claude

stem: A firm wants to recreate its on-premises datacenter setup in the cloud and move its existing workloads there. Which scenario and service type fit?
option_c: A finished expense app on SaaS
why_correct: In lift-and-shift migration you set up cloud resources similar to your on-premises datacenter and then move your workloads to the IaaS infrastructure.
why_a_wrong: Analytics and business intelligence is a PaaS scenario and does not recreate a datacenter.
why_c_wrong: A finished expense-tracking app is a SaaS example, not a recreated datacenter.
why_d_wrong: A development framework is a PaaS scenario for building apps, not for moving existing servers.
author: claude

stem: In platform as a service, what is the customer mainly responsible for?
option_a: The physical security of the datacenter
option_b: Licensing and patching the operating system
option_c: Their application code, data and access controls
option_d: Maintaining the middleware and development tools
why_correct: With PaaS you focus on your application code, data and access controls, while the provider handles the rest.
why_a_wrong: The provider is responsible for physical infrastructure and physical security.
why_b_wrong: The provider handles operating systems, so you do not worry about their licensing or patching.
why_d_wrong: The provider maintains the middleware and development tools.
author: claude

stem: A team of developers wants a framework with built-in scalability and high availability, so they write less code. Which service type fits?
option_d: Running servers in their own office
why_correct: PaaS provides a framework developers can build on, with features such as scalability, high availability and multitenant capability included.
why_a_wrong: IaaS rents hardware and leaves you to build and manage the rest.
why_b_wrong: SaaS is a finished application, not a framework to build on.
why_d_wrong: Servers in your own office are not a cloud service type.
author: claude

stem: A school uses a ready-made email and messaging app that the provider runs completely. The school only manages its users and data. Which service type is this?
why_correct: With SaaS you rent or use a fully developed application and the provider manages almost all of the stack. Email and messaging are common SaaS examples.
why_a_wrong: IaaS rents hardware and leaves you running the software.
why_b_wrong: PaaS gives a platform for building your own application code.
why_d_wrong: Vertical scaling is about giving a resource more CPU or RAM, not a service type.
author: claude

stem: In software as a service, what does the customer primarily manage?
option_c: Their data, identity and access settings, and device access
why_correct: In SaaS the provider manages almost the whole stack, and you primarily manage your data, identity and access settings, and device access posture.
why_a_wrong: The provider handles infrastructure patching in SaaS.
why_b_wrong: The provider handles application updates in SaaS.
why_d_wrong: The provider maintains the hardware in SaaS.
author: claude

objective_text: Identify appropriate use cases for each cloud service type (IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS)
stem: Which pairing of need and cloud service type is correct?
option_a: A finished finance and expense tracking app: IaaS
option_b: Rapidly starting up and shutting down test and development environments with full control: IaaS
why_correct: IaaS suits testing and development where you need to replicate configurations quickly and keep complete control.
why_a_wrong: A finished expense tracking app is a SaaS example, not IaaS.
why_c_wrong: Analytics and business intelligence is described as a PaaS scenario, not SaaS.
why_d_wrong: Email and messaging are common SaaS examples, not PaaS.
author: claude
